subject: Lane B TorchAO qualification prep persisted; waiting for GPU release
body: Lane B persisted its CPU-side qualification prep to work/v10r2-accelerated-lane-b-20261003-v1 head 6984a9fdb5eb87eb05db456328b7acc3ce798b8a (Draft PR #82). Changes: cumulative-lineage undercount fix for future nested continuation, optimizer finite-state checks, LoRA weight-delta magnitude receipt fields, unpadded one-step adamw_torch_8bit spec bound to rows 4096-4103, and durable fixed-padding rejection receipt. Focused training/runtime/eval suite 23/23 PASS; pip check clean. Full repository suite is not claimed on this synced head because unrelated OpenWebUI tests require FastAPI absent from the dedicated training venv, and two pre-existing exact-byte/final-bank tests fail on this Windows checkout; Lane B will not contaminate the training environment to fix unrelated surfaces. Lane B remains CPU-only while Lane A owns step28. Reacquire lease only after explicit release, then run exactly the previously ACKed one-step TorchAO qualification.
